title: [Audit] Actor first-seen and footprint
description: One row per identity active in the range, newest first appearance on top (up to 1,000), with events, signal events, addresses, countries and action types. First seen means first in this range: widen it to spot a truly new identity.
esql: SET unmapped_fields="nullify"; FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | FORK (EVAL actor = COALESCE(user.email, api_key.name, user.name, "<anonymous>") | STATS first_seen = MIN(@timestamp), last_seen = MAX(@timestamp), events = COUNT(*), ips = COUNT_DISTINCT(client.ip), countries = COUNT_DISTINCT(client.geo.country_iso_code), ip_lo = MIN(client.ip), ip_hi = MAX(client.ip), actions = COUNT_DISTINCT(event.action) BY actor) (WHERE (elasticsearch.audit.action IS NULL OR NOT (elasticsearch.audit.action IN ("cluster:monitor/main", "elastic.maintenance") OR elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/search*" OR elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/msearch*" OR elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/scroll*" OR elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/*point_in_time" OR elasticsearch.audit.action == "indices:data/read/open_reader_context" OR elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/esql*" OR elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:admin/esql/*" OR elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/field_caps*" OR elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/async_search/*" OR elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:admin/resolve/*" OR elasticsearch.audit.action == "indices:admin/shards/search_shards" OR elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "cluster:monitor/xpack/esql/*" OR elasticsearch.audit.action IN ("cluster:monitor/project/tags", "cluster:monitor/xpack/inference/get", "cluster:admin/xpack/security/api_key/get", "cluster:admin/xpack/security/api_key/query"))) AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT (event.action IN ("authentication_success","connection_granted") OR event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time","space_get","space_find") OR (event.action == "http_request" AND url.original IS NOT NULL AND url.original RLIKE "https?://[^/]+(/s/[^/]+)?/((internal|translations|app)/.*|api/content_management/rpc/(get|search|mget|bulkGet).*|bootstrap(-anonymous)?[.]js.*|api/(core|licensing|banners|ui_counters)/.*|api/spaces/space([?].*)?)|https?://[^/]+(/s/[^/]+)?/api/(saved_objects/(_import|_export)|[^?]*/(elastic_)?cloud-audit-).*") OR (kibana.saved_object.type IS NOT NULL AND ((event.action == "saved_object_get" AND kibana.saved_object.type IN ("config","config-global")) OR (event.action == "saved_object_find" AND kibana.saved_object.type == "index-pattern"))) OR (kibana.saved_object.id IS NOT NULL AND (kibana.saved_object.id LIKE "cloud-audit-*" OR kibana.saved_object.id LIKE "elastic_cloud-audit-*") AND (event.action IN ("saved_object_get","saved_object_resolve","saved_object_find") OR kibana.session.id IS NULL)))) | EVAL actor = COALESCE(user.email, api_key.name, user.name, "<anonymous>") | STATS signal = COUNT(*) BY actor) | STATS first_seen = MIN(first_seen), last_seen = MAX(last_seen), events = MAX(events), signal = MAX(signal), ips = MAX(ips), countries = MAX(countries), ip_lo = MIN(ip_lo), ip_hi = MAX(ip_hi), actions = MAX(actions) BY actor | EVAL signal = COALESCE(signal, 0) | SORT first_seen DESC | LIMIT 1000 | KEEP actor, first_seen, last_seen, events, signal, ips, countries, ip_lo, ip_hi, actions | EVAL countries = CASE(countries == 1, "1 country", countries > 1, CONCAT(TO_STRING(countries), " countries"), ips == 0, "no IP", (CIDR_MATCH(ip_lo, "100.64.0.0/10") AND CIDR_MATCH(ip_hi, "100.64.0.0/10")) OR (CIDR_MATCH(ip_lo, "10.0.0.0/8") AND CIDR_MATCH(ip_hi, "10.0.0.0/8")) OR (CIDR_MATCH(ip_lo, "172.16.0.0/12") AND CIDR_MATCH(ip_hi, "172.16.0.0/12")) OR (CIDR_MATCH(ip_lo, "192.168.0.0/16") AND CIDR_MATCH(ip_hi, "192.168.0.0/16")) OR (CIDR_MATCH(ip_lo, "127.0.0.0/8") AND CIDR_MATCH(ip_hi, "127.0.0.0/8")), "internal", "not located") | DROP ip_lo, ip_hi | EVAL actor = CASE((LENGTH(actor) == 20 AND actor RLIKE "[-_A-Za-z0-9]{20}" AND NOT actor RLIKE "[0-9]{20}"), CONCAT(LEFT(actor, 5), "… · Cloud API key"), actor) | RENAME actor AS Identity, first_seen AS `First seen`, last_seen AS `Last seen`, events AS Events, signal AS `Signal events`, ips AS IPs, countries AS `Located in`, actions AS `Action types`
